title: HDFC Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.

changes.label: Re-appointed
changes.reason: Re-appointed for a period of 1 year subject to shareholder approval.

profile.quote: Mr. V. Srinivasa Rangan, aged sixty-six (66) years, is the Executive Director of the Bank and heads the Human Resources, Corporate Legal, Group Oversight & Secretarial, Investment Banking, Information Security Group, Ethics Function and Fraud & Vigilance functions of the Bank. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Commerce from University of Delhi and is an Associate of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).
profile.summary: V. Srinivasa Rangan is an Executive Director at the bank heading various functions, holding a Commerce degree from Delhi University and an ICAI qualification.

headline: Re-appointed: V. Srinivasa Rangan, Whole-time Director (designated as Executive Director), from 23 Nov 2026
